judged_text: The new member endpoints are never exercised through the router: the automatic-group removal spec sends xhr :put, :remove_member although the route added in config/routes.rb is delete "members" => "groups#remove_member" (the working sibling spec uses :delete), and both add_members/remove_member specs inject group_id directly, which controller specs pass to the action without route recognition. The verb and parameter wiring of the brand-new routes is unverified — if the resources block yields the default :id param while the controller calls params.require(:group_id), every real add/remove from the UI raises ActionController::ParameterMissing and returns 400, and no test in this diff can detect it.
